reference: Key priorities of the future state
quote:
End-to-End Process Automation with Minimal Manual Intervention

- Automated, AI-powered data pipelines—from acquisition to dissemination— reduce manual effort, increase speed and quality, and enable real-time responsiveness across all stages of the statistical business process.
- Employee input focuses on higher value work, innovation, and interpretation, not execution.
justification: Explicit reference to automation and AI-powered pipelines from acquisition to dissemination implicates every GSBPM phase and sub-phase, as the text highlights end-to-end process impact.
update application to description reason: The phase description should clearly mention that needs identification, stakeholder engagement, business case formulation, and the evaluation of solution options are increasingly supported by automation and AI-driven processes, minimizing manual effort for routine or repetitive tasks and surfacing insights for human decision-makers. Employees in this phase focus on higher-value work such as contextualization, complex problem definition, and scenario evaluation, while AI/automation streamline the compilation and analysis of stakeholder needs, option assessment, and documentation.
